stem: Claire's paper ends abruptly and leaves the reader wondering what happens next. Which sentence should Claire add to the end of her paper?

options.label: F
options.text: He had made it down and had actually rappelled.

options.label: G
options.text: “Where's my snack?” he asked the counselors.

options.label: H
options.text: He didn't have a doubt about what he wanted to say.

options.label: J
options.text: “Can I do it again?” he shouted with excitement.
